<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial independence:</strong> Amidst ongoing protests and petitions, the Chief Justice of India emphasized that the judiciary remains firm against attempts to &quot;browbeat&quot; the institution.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a></span></li>
